verdict.rationale: The evidence shows GlitchTip ships a built-in MCP server that exposes its error, performance and log data to outside AI assistants. That is the server role, so it does not count toward this story. Nothing in the pack shows GlitchTip acting as an MCP client that can connect to external MCP servers and use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
